_description: Official X and Threads handles for social embed sourcing. Writers search these accounts for relevant posts to embed in article bodies. Organized by category with persons + organizations.
_usage: When writing about a person or topic, check this registry. If a match exists, search their X/Threads/Instagram for a recent relevant post and embed the URL on its own line in the article body. Prefer posts WITH photos/videos. Organization accounts are great for official announcements and event photos. The frontend auto-renders X, Instagram, and Threads embeds from bare URLs on their own line.
